title: Fix Missing Location Items in Sketchpad Detail Panel
description: Fix the sketchpad design detail panel so the Location property shows all expected nested tree items, including longitude and latitude. Patch the existing rendering path in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx, extend existing tests in place, verify with targeted checks, and keep the detail tree structure consistent.
summary: Fixed the sketchpad design detail panel Location section so the longitude and latitude steppers render through the shared labeled property-row path by adding showLabel to both rows in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx. Extended the existing inline Design Playwright assertions in the same file to require the Location section plus labeled longitude/latitude rows in the right details panel. Verification limits: the sketchpad Playwright workspace command still fails before loading inline tests with an existing CSS-loader/No tests found issue, and vite build for semio/sketchpad was killed by the environment after chunk rendering.
